Implemented on worktree branch worktree-agent-a31ceb204dea3849c at a17f2dfd plus review fixes 6763257b (not on main, not pushed).
MniTemplateBridge (atlas) executes 6Asym->2009c with TemplateFlow tpl-MNI152NLin2009cAsym_from-MNI152NLin6Asym (sha256 2e3869a0...), admitted by pinned digest and a 2009c res-01 lattice check. Its pull (2009c points to 6Asym) matches SimpleITK TransformPoint to 1e-8 mm at 23 landmark/lattice points (oracle: modules/atlas/jvm/src/test/resources/scalafim/atlas/oracle/templateflow_mni_bridge).
FINDING: TemplateFlow tpl-MNI152NLin6Asym_from-MNI152NLin2009cAsym (sha256 2a19853b...) pulls the SAME way as the forward file (T1w r 0.9433 used as named vs identity 0.9731; 0.9850 used as 2009c->6Asym). It is not an inverse and is refused.
The edge is pullback-only (TransformPlan.pullPoints) until withNumericalInverse: coverage 1.0, forward residual 1e-8 mm, reverse max 0.139 mm; vs ITK fixed-point inverse max 1.04e-2 mm (budget 0.05).
Caveat: parity tests are asset-gated and skip without a TemplateFlow cache; the inverse test takes 80-90 s.
